functions: followLine (b4), called forever from the loop at b3

actions.name: curve left (left wheel 7 %, right 22 %) without end
curve right (left wheel 22 %, right 7 %) without end

control_flow: followLine: read the line tracker's brightness; if it is below 30 %, curve left; else if it is above 70 %, curve right; else drive straight.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker reads below 30 % (black); second: it reads above 70 % (white band or plain floor)

branches.outcome: black floor: the robot curves left
bright floor: the robot curves right
in between (30 to 70 %): the robot drives straight

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black, curves right on the bright floor, and drives straight in between
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line, or beside it on the bright floor

scenarios.title: Follows the line
assumptions: The end of the line is where the robot should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end

uncertainties: The line tracker reads 30 to 70 % only for a moment at the edge of the line's black core, so the straight-ahead outcome may happen briefly or not at all in a run.
